meet.speaker: {rival}
meet.text: {rival}, a youth of your own age, blocks the path with a pack of hangers-on. "So you are the one who woke on Meditation Rock the same morning I did. The elders say the heavens like a matching pair. I say only one of us climbs."

choices.label: Then I will climb past you.

successor.speaker: {rival}
successor.text: {rival} waits at a bend in the path, alone, arms folded, as if the spot had been chosen. "You are {player}. The one who called you rival is gone, and the name of an enemy should not be left lying in the road. I have heard how you climbed. I mean to take that place, and I mean to deserve it."

choices.label: Then keep up. I will not slow down for you.
No one takes a place. It has to be earned.

successor_vow.speaker: {rival}
successor_vow.text: {rival} grins, sharp and unashamed. "Good. I would think less of you if you slowed down. We shall see whose road is longer."

successor_nod.speaker: {rival}
successor_nod.text: "Earned, then." {rival} inclines their head, only a finger's width. "I will remember you said it, when I stand beside you or over you."

successor_quiet.text: You bow and walk on. Behind you {rival} does not call out. The stranger has made a promise, and it weighs more than your silence. That night you sit a little longer on the cold stone.

swallow.text: You swallow the insult and step aside. The laughter fades behind you, but not the sting. That night you sit a little longer on the cold stone.

vow.text: {rival}'s smile thins. "Words are cheap, {player}. We shall see whose bones the heavens keep." The crowd parts, and neither of you looks away first.

scorn.speaker: {rival}
scorn.text: "Together?" A scornful laugh. "A path that narrow has room for one. Remember that when you see my back."
